m.s: Rinse {rice} until the water runs clear. Put it in a saucepan with 1½ times its volume of cold water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, then cover and cook on low for 12 minutes. Rest off the heat for 10 minutes with the lid on, then stir through {ricevinegar} and a pinch of sugar.
Heat the grill to high. Pat {salmon} dry and lay it skin side down on a lined tray. Spread the glaze thickly over the tops.
Grill for 7 to 9 minutes without turning, until the glaze is blistered and dark in spots and the salmon just flakes in the thickest part. Watch it closely at the end, as miso catches fast.
Meanwhile cut {broccoli} into florets and trim {greenbeans}. Steam or boil them for 4 minutes until bright green, then toss with {sesameoil}, a pinch of salt and {sesameseeds}.
Serve the salmon on the rice with the greens, sliced {springonion} and wedges of {lime}.

l: Flake the salmon over rice and greens. Best eaten cold or barely warm. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
g: Use a GF miso (many contain barley, so check) and tamari instead of soy, glazing the GF fillets separately.
